skill.name: module-health
skill.description: Assess Logseq Template Graph modules for size balance, cohesion, documentation, dependencies, and maintainability. Produce health scores and practical reorganization guidance.
skill.summary: Score module structure, identify architecture issues, and plan focused refactoring.

content.value_statement: Unbalanced modules and unclear dependencies make Logseq templates difficult to maintain. This skill scores module health and recommends focused structural improvements.
actual_capabilities: Counts classes and properties in each source module.
Scores module size, documentation, completeness, ratios, and organization.
Flags bloated modules, small modules, empty modules, and missing documentation.
Analyzes cross-module references and identifies coupling or circular dependencies.
Suggests module splits, merges, migration steps, priorities, and effort estimates.
limitations: The workflow expects the Logseq Template Graph source layout and EDN naming conventions.
Health thresholds are heuristics and may not fit every project domain.
The included scripts measure structure but do not automatically map dependencies.
Trend analysis requires accessible Git history and comparable earlier revisions.

use_cases.title: Review Current Module Health
use_cases.description: Generate a scored overview before deciding which modules need attention.

use_cases.title: Plan Architecture Refactoring
use_cases.description: Identify natural module boundaries and create a prioritized reorganization plan.

use_cases.title: Validate a New Module
use_cases.description: Check size, documentation, references, and consistency before submitting changes.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Quick Health Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check module health in the current Logseq Template Graph. Show scores, key counts, and the three most important issues.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this for a first review of the repository.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One Module
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the [module name] module in detail. Explain its score, cohesion, documentation, dependencies, and practical improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when one module needs focused assessment.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Architecture Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare current module health with [revision or date]. Summarize score changes, growth, new coupling, and regressions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this to review architecture trends over time.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reorganization Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a reorganization plan for [module name]. Group classes by domain, map dependency impacts, define migration steps, and estimate effort.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before a complex structural refactor.

output_examples.input: Check module health and show the main concerns.
output_examples.output: Overall health: 73 out of 100. Eight modules are healthy. The misc module is bloated, and two small modules need review.

output_examples.input: How should the misc module be reorganized?
output: Split communication, medical, financial, and education classes into focused modules.
Keep only items without a stable domain in misc.
Update references, build configuration, documentation, and validation checks in that order.

output_examples.output: The module has strong documentation and clear cohesion. Its high property ratio needs contextual review, but its structure remains maintainable.

best_practices: Review score details before accepting a recommendation.
Confirm cross-module references before moving classes or properties.
Run validation and compare health scores after each structural change.
anti_patterns: Do not split modules only to satisfy a numeric threshold.
Do not move classes without updating dependent references and build configuration.
Do not treat the common module like a standard domain module.

faq.question: What projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It is designed for the Logseq Template Graph modular source structure and its EDN files.

faq.question: Does the skill modify project files?
faq.answer: The health-check scripts only read files and print results. Apply proposed refactoring separately after review.

faq.question: How is a module score calculated?
faq.answer: The score combines size balance, documentation, completeness, class-to-property ratio, and organization.

faq.question: Can it detect circular dependencies?
faq.answer: The guided analysis can inspect cross-module references. The included health-check scripts do not automate this dependency mapping.

faq.question: Does it compare changes over time?
faq.answer: Yes. Trend analysis can compare module counts and architecture changes when Git history is available.

faq.question: Are the health thresholds mandatory?
faq.answer: No. They are guidelines that should be adjusted for shared modules, project maturity, and domain needs.
